name: official-extensions
description: Plugins, themes, engines, and transports for degoog search.
author: fccview

plugins.name: 4play status
plugins.description: !4play shows live 4play transport status. Access can be admin-only, open, or locked.

plugins.name: AI Summary
plugins.description: Summarizes search results. Works with OpenAI-compatible APIs, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, Gemini, and Anthropic.

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.description: Shows weather information using Open-Meteo.

plugins.name: Define
plugins.description: Look up word definitions using the Free Dictionary API.

plugins.name: Time
plugins.description: Show current time in a timezone or city.

plugins.name: QR Code
plugins.description: Generate a QR code for a URL.

plugins.name: Password
plugins.description: Generate a random password.

plugins.name: Search history
plugins.description: Stores search history in data/history.json with timestamps; !history shows a paginated, deletable list.

plugins.name: TMDb
plugins.description: Shows movie/TV show details above search results.

plugins.name: Math
plugins.description: Evaluates math in the search bar and shows a calculator.

plugins.name: Jellyfin
plugins.description: Search your Jellyfin media library.

plugins.name: RomM
plugins.description: Search your RomM game library.

plugins.name: Colors
plugins.description: Generate a five-color palette. Space to shuffle, click to lock.

plugins.name: Meilisearch
plugins.description: Search across your Meilisearch indexes.

plugins.name: Home RSS Feeds
plugins.description: Shows RSS feed items above search results.

plugins.name: FreshRSS
plugins.description: Shows feeds from your FreshRSS instance, same layout as the home RSS plugin, through the FreshRSS API.

plugins.name: GitHub
plugins.description: When results include GitHub repos or users, a card appears above the list.

plugins.name: Apps pocket
plugins.description: App grid next to the settings icon. You manage the list in plugin settings.

plugins.name: Engine stats
plugins.description: Records per-engine response times, failure rates and result counts, then shows them with !engine-stats.

plugins.name: Spell Check
plugins.description: Intercepts search queries and corrects spelling using Yandex Speller.

plugins.name: DuckDuckGo bang redirect
plugins.description: Type !! followed by any ddg bang command to trigger them directly from degoog. This WILL route through duckduckgo. Find all available commands here: https://duckduckgo.com/bangs

plugins.name: Custom Bangs
plugins.description: Define your own bang shortcuts that redirect to any site, optionally injecting your query into a URL template. Type !<shortcut> terms, leading or trailing.

plugins.name: Highlight Terms
plugins.description: Wraps query-matching words in <strong> on result titles and snippets on every search page.

plugins.name: OIDC / SSO
plugins.description: Locks settings behind any OpenID Connect provider. Puts an avatar on the home page for the signed-in user.

plugins.name: Dynacat
plugins.description: Puts Dynacat widgets on the home page and behind !dynacat. The token stays on the server. A picker sets which widgets show, how wide they are, and in what order.

themes.name: Zen
themes.description: Paper-colored theme with Bricolage Grotesque and Junicode.

themes.name: Dynacat
themes.description: Dynacat's dashboard colors on degoog. Violet-tinted neutrals, one purple accent, monospace type, flat 5px corners.

transports.name: FlareSolverr
transports.description: Sends requests through FlareSolverr to get past Cloudflare. Engines pick it as their outgoing transport once it is set up.

transports.name: Browserless
transports.description: Fetches pages through Browserless or any headless browser that accepts POST /content. It runs JavaScript and returns HTML, which is what you want for engines like Google Images that ignore a normal HTTP request. Works with browserless/chromium and CloakBrowser wrappers.

transports.name: CloakBrowser
transports.description: Fetches pages through CloakBrowser, a stealth Chromium that patches navigator.webdriver, canvas, and CDP leaks in C++. Gets past Google and Cloudflare. Docker setup lives in homelab/cloakbrowser.

transports.name: Camoufox
transports.description: Fetches pages through Camoufox, a stealth Firefox that patches bot-detection signals in C++. Gets past Google and Cloudflare. Docker setup lives at Korosys/camoufox-degoog.

transports.name: 4play (lolcat)
transports.description: Fetches pages with a real Firefox session through the official lolcat 4play browser extension.

engines.name: Google
engines.description: Google web search. Needs the 4play lolcat transport, because Google stopped returning results over plain HTTP. Use Google CSE if you cannot run 4play.

engines.name: Google CSE
engines.description: Google Custom Search.

engines.name: Google Images
engines.description: Google image search. Pick JSON or HTML in engine settings. Each mode points you at the matching transport in the Store.

engines.name: Google Videos
engines.description: Google video search.

engines.name: Bing
engines.description: Bing web search.

engines.name: Bing Images
engines.description: Bing image search.

engines.name: Bing Videos
engines.description: Bing video search.

engines.name: Bing News
engines.description: Bing news search.

engines.name: Brave Search
engines.description: Brave web search by scraping HTML. For API access use Brave API Search.

engines.name: Brave News
engines.description: Brave news search.

engines.name: DuckDuckGo
engines.description: DuckDuckGo web search.

engines.name: Wikipedia
engines.description: Wikipedia search through the MediaWiki API.

engines.name: Reddit
engines.description: Reddit post search through the public RSS feed.

engines.name: Ecosia
engines.description: Ecosia web search. Cloudflare often blocks the server and you get nothing. Use another engine when that happens.

engines.name: Startpage
engines.description: Startpage web search. Handles the Anubis proof-of-work gate itself, so you do not need a browser transport. Turn on Anonymous View if you want result links to open through Startpage's proxy.

engines.name: Internet Archive
engines.description: File-type engine for archive.org. Books, software, whatever they have.

engines.name: Lemmy World
engines.description: Lemmy search for posts, comments, and communities.

engines.name: Brave API Search
engines.description: Brave web search through their API, not the HTML page.

engines.name: DuckDuckGo Images
engines.description: DuckDuckGo image search. About 70 images per page.

engines.name: Brave Images
engines.description: Brave image search by scraping the results page.

engines.name: Openverse
engines.description: CC-licensed images from Flickr, Wikimedia, and museum collections, through the Openverse API.

engines.name: Wikimedia Commons
engines.description: Wikimedia Commons images through the MediaWiki API.

engines.name: NASA Images
engines.description: NASA Image and Video Library search.

engines.name: Hacker News
engines.description: Hacker News stories through the Algolia API.

engines.name: DuckDuckGo News
engines.description: DuckDuckGo news search.

engines.name: The Guardian
engines.description: Guardian news through the Open Platform API. Needs a free key from open-platform.theguardian.com.

engines.name: DuckDuckGo Videos
engines.description: DuckDuckGo video search using the v.js JSON endpoint.

engines.name: Brave Videos
engines.description: Brave video search by scraping the video results page.

engines.name: Startpage Images
engines.description: Startpage image search with thumbnails proxied through Startpage.

engines.name: Startpage Videos
engines.description: Startpage video search fetched anonymously through Startpage.

engines.name: Startpage News
engines.description: Startpage news search. Each result names its outlet.

autocomplete.name: Brave Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Suggestions from Brave Search. No API key required. Add one if you want authenticated requests.

shortcuts.name: Next tab
shortcuts.description: Switch to the next visible results tab.

shortcuts.name: Previous tab
shortcuts.description: Switch to the previous visible results tab.

shortcuts.name: Switch tab by number
shortcuts.description: Hold the recorded modifier and press 1-9 to jump to that result tab.

shortcuts.name: Go home
shortcuts.description: Return to the Degoog home page.

shortcuts.name: Highlight next result
shortcuts.description: Move focus to the next result link.

shortcuts.name: Highlight previous result
shortcuts.description: Move focus to the previous result link.
